title: Pronouns
info: A pronoun takes the place of a noun. Examples: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.
Using pronouns avoids repeating the same name again and again.

questions.q: Replace "Maria" with a pronoun: Maria runs → ___ runs.

options: More than one person or thing
